verdict.rationale: No evidence of user-defined rule-based automation (e.g., 'if X happens, do Y' triggers, scheduled tasks, or event-driven workflows) anywhere in the Perplexity evidence pack. The product offers search, chat, an Assistant, and a Computer/MCP agent for on-demand tasks, but nothing describes persistent trigger/action rules tied to events. Missing for 10: any documentation of automation rules, triggers, scheduled/event-based execution, or workflow builders.
